entry.title: Plymouth

p.strong: Stopped sending at 5:58pm (GMT) on Friday 23 February 2024

div.p:
Issued by Plymouth City Council. The WWII bomb found in Keyham will be transported today 23 February 2024 at 2pm to Torpoint Ferry slipway via Saltash Road. A time limited cordon will be in place along this route between 2pm until an estimated 5pm. You are asked to leave and stay away from the cordoned area for this time period.
For more information about the route, cordon and support - go to the Plymouth City Council website. Visit gov.uk/alerts for more information.

entry.title: River Roe and River Ive from Highbridge to Stockdalewath

p.strong: Stopped sending at 6:37am (BST) on Thursday 23 May 2024

div.p: From the Environment Agency. Severe flooding is happening now, 23rd May on River Roe and River Ive from Highbridge to Stockdalewath, in the Stockdalewath Area in the parish of Dalston. Flood waters are expected to rise rapidly. Flooding is likely to cut off the area. Floodwater is a threat to life - do not enter. Remain in a safe location. Flood water may contain dangerous debris. Be aware of your surroundings and stay safe. Do not drive through or attempt to enter flood water. Follow instructions of emergency services in your area. Call 999 if in immediate danger. Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to see floodwater. For more information search gov.uk/alerts or search for 'Check for flooding'

entry.title: Bath and North East Somerset, Bristol, City of, Devon, North Somerset, Somerset, South Gloucestershire

p.strong: Stopped sending at 11:00am (GMT) on Saturday 07 December 2024

div.p:
Issued by the UK Government
A RED warning for wind has been issued in your area. Extremely strong winds associated with Storm Darragh are expected to cause significant disruption from 3.00am on Saturday 07 December 2024. Strong winds can cause flying debris, falling trees and large waves around coastal areas, all of which can present a danger to life. Stay indoors if you can. It is not safe to drive in these conditions.
The storm may damage infrastructure causing power cuts and disruption to mobile phone coverage. Consider gathering torches, batteries, a mobile phone power pack and other essential items you already have at home.
Stay up to date with the weather forecast for your area and follow advice from emergency services, network operators and local authorities. For more information search online for 'gov.uk/alerts' or Met Office warnings and advice.

entry.title: River Soar at caravan parks near Barrow upon Soar

p.strong: Stopped sending at 12:21pm (GMT) on Tuesday 07 January 2025

div.p: Issued by Environment Agency. Severe flooding is happening now on 6th January at Proctor's Pleasure Park near Barrow upon Soar area. Flooding is likely to cut off the area and may contain dangerous debris. Emergency services are evacuating the caravan park and a rest centre has been opened at the Methodist Church Hall (North Street, Barrow upon Soar, LE12 8QA), go there now if it is safe to do so. Avoid contact with floodwater if possible. For more information search gov.uk/alerts or search for 'Check for flooding'.

entry.title: England, Wales

p.strong: Stopped sending at 11:00pm (BST) on Friday 14 August 2026

div.p:
Issued by the UK Government
There is a very high risk of wildfires nationally. Residents, landowners and visitors should not undertake any activity that could start a fire, including disposable barbecues, firepits, garden incinerators or fireworks. Even a small flame can rapidly develop into a major wildfire placing lives, homes, businesses and emergency responders at risk.
Follow official updates and report signs of fire immediately by calling 999. Search gov.uk/alerts for more information.
